class.name: HaxeSyntaxHighlighter
class.brief_description: A Haxe syntax highlighter that can be used with [TextEdit] and [CodeEdit] nodes.
class.description: Highlights `.hx` source with the editor's Haxe colors: comments (including doc comments), strings and string interpolation, `@:` metadata, numbers, keywords, engine and project types, and conditional-compilation directives. It is applied to Haxe scripts by the script editor; it can also be assigned to a [TextEdit] or [CodeEdit] node to show Haxe code elsewhere in the editor. [b]Note:[/b] This class can only be used for editor plugins because it relies on editor settings.
